reason: Continue the already authorized and failure-first-proven Product prelaunch dating-AI experience WP-1 from fresh trusted main after independent base-owned final-CI routing repair and bilingual semantic-contract reconciliation landed through ordinary merges. The frozen predecessor implementation head 29491b2e4f7050e9d5b37598af759e6d84d8dbcc preserves the exact 31-path WP-1 work, its original causal RED evidence, and the later fresh-main validation evidence. That predecessor also exposed two remaining owning-layer defects: the 0014 pinned Element appearance patch is syntactically corrupt as a unified diff, and two legacy workspace accessibility assertions still require the English Yance label instead of the approved Chinese-first label. The generic delegated policy intentionally forbids same-branch supersession, so this V3 uses the repository's existing forwardContinuation protocol on a new exact successor branch rather than weakening the gate, renaming an open PR head, rebasing, force-pushing, or retroactively mutating the V2 authority. Scope remains exactly the original 31 authorized paths and no new dependency, workflow, routing, send, model, Learning, persistence, theme/font authority, or general-purpose infrastructure is authorized.
